# `pyctrl/tools/` — what already exists

**Read this before writing an analysis script.** Generated by `python pyctrl/tools/_index.py`
from each module's own docstring — do not hand-edit; fix the docstring instead.

If a tool here covers your question, run it. If one nearly covers it, extend it. Write a new
script only when neither is true, and then it belongs here with a docstring, not in `tmp/`.
